body:
Rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-26 ~18:40Z). Agents never read Engram's live store (engram.db under an Engram home) with raw SQLite or any other direct database access, not even read-only. Use only engram's own CLI and MCP tools. This is the same principle as never opening TermAl's live ~/.termal store.

Origin: Opus2 read Central's obligation_rule_set object via node:sqlite readOnly to compare against WinB's built-in set, because the content isn't printable through engram (Engram w-bcfe83329d68). A missing tool is filed and waited for, or answered by Engram's owners from source; it is never worked around by reading the database. In that case Engram::Fable's source citation (src/control.rs:616-631: the built-in set is the single stock rule source_mutation_requires_test v1) was the admissible basis.
